input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input_dir.description: Input folder containing FASTQ files. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

output_dir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

assemblies.description: Folder of pre-assembled FASTA files (.fa/.fasta) to use instead of reads. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

plasmid_min_length.description: Minimum length (bp, inclusive) of a circular contig to be extracted as a plasmid FASTA

clustering.description: Plasmid clustering method to run on all extracted plasmids. Currently: 'pling'. Not run when unset.

pling_sourmash.description: Use sourmash to pre-filter plasmid pairs in Pling (faster for large datasets)

pling_args.description: Extra options passed as-is to 'pling cluster align'

skip_bakta.description: Skip Bakta annotation of the extracted plasmids

bakta_db.description: Path to an existing Bakta database folder (the db/ or db-light/ folder). If not set, the database is downloaded once into --bakta_db_cache.

bakta_db_type.description: Bakta database type to download when --bakta_db is not set: 'light' (~1.3 GB download, 3.9 GB unpacked) or 'full' (~30 GB download, 84 GB unpacked)

bakta_db_cache.description: Folder where a downloaded Bakta database is kept and reused between runs

plasmid_max_length.description: Maximum length (bp, exclusive) of a circular contig to be extracted as a plasmid FASTA

max_memory.description: Maximum memory to use for each process

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs to use for each process

max_time.description: Maximum time to use for each process
